name: codex-session-notifier
description: Monitor local and SSH Codex sessions and receive reply completion notifications through pushplus channels.

commands.title: Codex Session Notifier: Select Notification Channel
Codex Session Notifier: Configure pushplus Token
Codex Session Notifier: Send Test Notification
Codex Session Notifier: Remove pushplus Token
Codex Session Notifier: Show Delivery Status

codexSessionNotifier.enabled.description: Automatically monitor this window's local or SSH Codex source. Delivery is enabled separately with Enable Notifications.

codexSessionNotifier.machineLabel.description: Optional label for this source. Empty uses the actual host returned by the reader.

codexSessionNotifier.sources.description: Per-source overrides keyed by local or an existing SSH Host alias.

codexSessionNotifier.codexHome.description: Codex home on the selected host. Empty uses that host's CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

codexSessionNotifier.sshHost.description: Existing SSH Host alias override for this remote window. Empty discovers plain or encoded Remote SSH authorities, preserving their user and port.

codexSessionNotifier.pythonExecutable.description: Existing local Python executable. Empty uses python on Windows and python3 elsewhere. No packages are installed.

codexSessionNotifier.sshExecutable.description: Existing local SSH executable. Empty uses the system OpenSSH client. Does not change system or Remote SSH settings.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --pre-release --githubBranch publish --out artifacts/codex-session-notifier-0.0.22.vsix
scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/*.test.js && python -I -m unittest discover -s test -p test_*.py
